nodes.label: Good partner version
nodes.text: Describe what makes a good partner in detailed, human terms, while also covering the AI-partner case explicitly.

nodes.label: Canonical home enforcement
nodes.text: Assign one primary home to each repeated idea cluster and route related entries to it with explicit links.

nodes.label: Out-of-the-box thinking
nodes.text: Think broadly and creatively while still converging on a structured, testable next step.

nodes.label: Single question mode plan
nodes.text: Make the engine ask one focused question, optionally show numbered options, score the answer, and evaluate it before continuing.

nodes.label: DB improvement control flow
nodes.text: Improve the DB by tightening retrieval, reducing overlap, and strengthening links instead of adding more schema.

nodes.label: Dependency-first planning
nodes.text: Uncover hidden dependencies before execution

nodes.label: Seven Basic Tools of Quality integration
nodes.text: Integrate the Seven Basic Tools of Quality into continuity.db as a reusable analysis layer for quality, drift, and improvement work.

nodes.label: High quality code plan
nodes.text: Create code that is correct, clear, maintainable, tested, secure, fit for purpose, and reuse-aware.

nodes.label: AI misuse harm-reduction workspace
nodes.text: Analyze concrete ways to reduce AI misuse risks: deception, fraud, cyber abuse, unsafe repurposing, and concentration of power.

nodes.label: War harm reduction workspace
nodes.text: Analyze concrete, urgent ways to reduce civilian harm, preserve truth, and support peace under war conditions.

nodes.label: Successful strategy sequence
nodes.text: Make the most effective thinking strategies easy to apply in a reliable order.

nodes.label: Core thinking patterns
nodes.text: Operationalize failure-mode scan, decision-option comparison, and hypothesis-test-update as reusable thinking patterns.

nodes.label: Reasoning pattern reuse plan
nodes.text: Make successful reasoning patterns reusable across similar problems.

nodes.label: Learn topic fast
nodes.text: Learn a new topic quickly with a small, testable, feedback-rich loop that uses named patterns explicitly.

nodes.label: Reasoning improvement comparisons
nodes.text: Make before/after episode comparisons a standard part of important reasoning.

nodes.label: Battle-Proven Thinking Way
nodes.text: Use adversarial questioning and thin-slice execution to choose implementation options that survive stress tests.

nodes.label: Constraint-First Thinking
nodes.text: Solve real problems by starting with constraints, assumptions, and testable next steps.

nodes.label: Project phase 0
nodes.text: Define the project foundation before execution by clarifying purpose, goal, and outcome.

nodes.label: Explore-to-build threshold
nodes.text: Decide how to know when to stop exploring and start building in the thinking cycle.

nodes.label: Disciplined thinking demo
nodes.text: Demonstrate how the DB supports disciplined thinking through goals, conditional recall, reasoning episodes, trust, and formal analysis.

nodes.label: Reasoning episode model plan
nodes.text: Design and capture reasoning episodes as auditable DB objects.

nodes.label: Thinking cycle operationalization
nodes.text: Operationalize the thinking cycle: explore, test, build, correct, synthesize, repeat.

nodes.label: Default vs conditional memory recall
nodes.text: Decide what the system should remember by default and what should only surface under conditions.

nodes.label: Strengthen democracy plan
nodes.text: Turn the democratic synthesis into concrete actions.

nodes.label: Trust reasoning episode plan
nodes.text: Evaluate whether trust should become a first-class DB concept.
